name: Cu Chi beef noodle soup
summary: Beef noodle soup with soft, fragrant beef in a rich broth and soft noodles.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế, on 11 Aug 2024, describes bún bò Củ Chi and ties the beef to the local veal.
howToEat: Noodles and beef in the broth.
